_README: PLACEHOLDER scaffold for scripts/relocation-career-strategy.mjs. This file is COMMITTED and contains NO real personal data. To use the tool: copy this to data/relocation-profile.json (which is gitignored) and replace every value with your own. The script reads the real file if present, otherwise falls back to this example with a warning.

individual.name: Alex Example
individual.current_comp_estimate: current total comp likely in the $140K–$190K range (senior IC/PgM)

  - System two: short description of what it does and the measurable outcome
Generic tooling: orchestration, pipelines, prompt engineering, automation
Prior career: several years in an adjacent field before the current role
Languages and stacks: list them here

Public values or identity facts relevant to employer fit and risk assessment.
